home.whyItem1Desc: Once emptied, a plastic bottle contains nothing but air. Yet since it still needs to be collected and processed, that air-filled bottle takes up just as much space as a full one — all the way to the recycling plant.
home.whyItem2Title: Your recycling bags fill up fast
home.whyItem2Desc: All that useless air fills your recycling bags in no time — 2 to 3 times more than you actually need.
home.whyItem2Stat: Over 75 recycling bags used per household every year
home.whyItem3Title: Street bins overflow long before collection day
home.whyItem3Desc: Same problem at neighbourhood level: bins overflow and illegal dumping multiplies.
home.whyItem3Stat: Taking out the recycling becomes a messy, unpleasant chore
home.whyItem4Title: Hours lost managing overstuffed bags and extra trips
home.whyItem4Desc: Back-and-forth to collection points, bags full too soon… All that bulk quietly eats into your time without you noticing.
home.whyItem5Title: Hidden costs that quietly add up
home.whyItem5Desc: Extra recycling bags, fuel for collection trips… Poorly organised sorting costs more than you think, year after year.

founders.headline: Meet Skimstones' founders
founders.missionText: Because waste is a resource, SKIMSTONES exists to transform what is too often seen as a constraint into real, measurable value. We structure, de-risk and coordinate waste treatment and recovery projects, actively contributing to the energy transition — through realistic, fundable and scalable solutions for industrial players across the globe.
founders.visionText: SKIMSTONES aspires to become the global reference for waste recovery and fossil energy substitution solutions — building a world where nothing is wasted, and everything is transformed.
founders.valuesText: Like a stone skipping on water, at SKIMSTONES we believe a single positive action can set off a chain of ripples. Solidarity, systemic thinking, hard work and a sense of humour fuel our momentum.
